title: CILantro run status
description: Where a run has got to, written to disk while it runs so that something other than the caller holding the call can find out. Written as `cilantro/NAME.status.json` by a run given `--status`, and by every run the MCP server's `start_unpack` begins. A run takes minutes, so a caller with a shorter timeout than the run needs somewhere to look that is not the return value.

Schema.description: Which version of this shape the object is. Read it first and refuse a major version you were not written for.

Phase.description: What the run is doing, and the first thing to branch on. Deliberately coarse: a watcher either keeps waiting, reads the manifest, or gives up.

Pass.description: The pass now running, or null where the run is not in one. A name rather than a number, because the pass list is not a stable numbering.

PassesDone.description: How many passes have been decided — run, skipped or refused. Skipped ones count, so that a fraction shown to a person advances instead of stalling on passes the plan left out.

PassesTotal.description: How many passes the plan has, known before the first one starts.

ObservedUtc.description: When the run last said anything. The field that separates a slow run from a dead one: a run writes here every few seconds, so nothing for a minute means the process is gone. A killed run leaves its last phase behind looking current forever, and only the staleness of this gives it away.

ProcessId.description: Which process is doing the work, so that a watcher which finds a stale heartbeat can confirm what it suspects rather than guess.

Result.description: The full manifest, once there is one. Present exactly where Phase is `finished`, so that a caller polling this file never has to go and read a second one.

Error.description: Why the run stopped, where it stopped for a reason worth stating. Set where Phase is `failed` or `cancelled`.

Ended.description: Whether the run is over, whatever the outcome. The one question a polling loop asks every time round, said as one field so that three phases do not have to be enumerated at every call site.
